content.text:
I've submitted **index 18 (Sb 0.34 / Y 0.66)** as the best composition, with a measured EQE of 0.114%. All 3 merit measurements are used up.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 28 | 0.63 | 0.081 |
| 14 | 0.23 | 0.105 |
| 18 | 0.34 | **0.114** |

- **How I picked:** I measured one Sb-rich point and one Y-rich point first. The third went to index 18, the top pick from the tool's model-based suggestion.
- **What the numbers suggest:** EQE is highest at intermediate Sb content and drops toward the Sb-rich end. The whole library is weak, which is expected: these oxides mostly don't absorb the 2.1 eV illumination.
- **What wasn't checked:** Three points can't pin down where the peak is. The best composition could be a neighbour of index 18, roughly Sb 0.28–0.45, which I never measured. I also didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so I haven't confirmed which crystal phase index 18 actually is.
